meta.name: add-emacs
meta.description: Add Emacs as a channel. Opens an interactive chat buffer and org-mode integration so you can talk to NanoClaw from within Emacs (Doom, Spacemacs, or vanilla). Local HTTP bridge — no bot token or external service needed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在 Emacs 中与 AI 对话，无需外部服务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Emacs 并想直接在编辑器里与 AI 交互
copy.tagline_en: Chat with AI inside Emacs, no external service needed
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Emacs and want to interact with AI directly from your editor

howto.what: 装上后，你可以在 Emacs 里打开聊天窗口直接和 AI 对话；也可以选中代码或 org 文本发送，AI 的回复会作为子标题出现在 org 文件里，还能处理会议纪要、草稿改写等。
howto.when: 当你用 Emacs 快捷键打开聊天窗口发送消息，或对 org 标题/选区执行发送命令时触发。前提是已启用该渠道。

say.text: 帮我解释这段代码为什么报错
say.note: 回复会出现在聊天 buffer 里

say.text: 把当前 org 标题下的内容整理成行动项
say.note: 结果会作为子标题插入

say.text: 把这段草稿改写得更正式一些

howto.what_en: After installation, you can open a chat window inside Emacs and talk to the AI directly. You can also send selected code or org text; the reply appears as a child heading in the org file. It can also summarize meeting notes, rewrite drafts, etc.
howto.when_en: Fires when you open the chat buffer via an Emacs keybinding and send a message, or run the send command on an org heading/region. Channel must be enabled.

say_en.text: Explain why this code throws an error.
say_en.note: The reply appears in the chat buffer.

say_en.text: Turn the content under this org heading into action items.
say_en.note: The result is inserted as a child heading.

say_en.text: Rewrite this draft in a more formal tone.
